titleText: JTF News: The Guardian, UN News
mainText: A health worker is being monitored for Ebola in a London hospital after working in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
President Volodymyr Zelensky removed Ukraine's top army commander following protests.
President Daniel Ortega of Nicaragua stated the country will hold no more elections.
Hungarian prosecutors conducted a raid on a data center belonging to Prime Minister Viktor Orbán's party as part of an embezzlement investigation.
The United Nations reported 144 migrants and refugees dead or missing off the coast of Mauritania.
